messages:
carmen: Got paged twice by kv-cache flap overnight. Both were <1m but still escalated. Can we agree on a short-term quieting change and assign an owner for the follow-ups?
noah: yep saw those. This is model_serving.kv_cache.flap. Current behavior pages immediately on 5x spike.
zara: short-term proposal: require 3m steady increase then page. add 15m suppression keyed by alert fingerprint. also emit a suppressed_event_count metric so we can quantify noise.
carmen: works for me. can we also make the suppression configurable per env? staging minimal, prod stricter.
noah: will make suppression an alert label and config map override per env. i can open a small PR to prometheus rules.
oncall-bot: Staging deploy recorded: prometheus/rules updated by noah at 1779991400.
zara: follow-ups I'll own: 1) remediation ticket + runbook blurb about flap vs sustained (ETA 48h) 2) add suppressed_event_count to dashboards (ETA 72h). noah: you'll do the dedupe key + config (ETA next Tue).
noah: PR: https://git.internal/repo/prom-alerts/pull/512 (adjusts for/suppression + test). validation logs attached.
carmen: can we canary to two clusters tomorrow 09:15 PT and monitor error budget for 30m before broad rollout?
noah: plan sounds good. I'll post deploy note and canary schedule.
zara: scheduling 30m sync Fri 16:00 UTC to review initial numbers and decide final thresholds. added task in RMD-3577.
carmen: one more ask: add a one-liner to the oncall playbook saying "do not escalate single <2m flaps unless accompanied by increase in 5xx or latency". zara can you draft?
zara: will draft and attach to runbook task.
oncall-bot: Reminder: kv-cache follow-up sync scheduled at 1779998400 (Fri 16:00 UTC). Attendees: carmen, noah, zara.
carmen: thanks team. i'll close the loop after the sync and update the incident-pattern tag.
noah: monitoring through the night, will post if anything regresses.
zara: thanks all. :white_check_mark:
